summary: New Contact Modal Does not appear after Creating Customer
reported_issue: After creating a new customer on Staging, the system does not open the new contact modal (sometimes it appears briefly and then closes automatically). Not reproducible on Production.
expected_after_fix: After creating a new customer, the New Contact modal should open (as it does on Production) so the user can immediately add a contact.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, navigated to Customers.
Clicked New Customer, filled Name = 'ZZAUTOTEST Cust 22878', clicked Save.
Polled for 6 seconds watching for a New Contact / Add Contact modal (q-dialog visibility + contact-form text).
actual_now: After Save, the app navigated directly to the new customer's detail page (ZZAUTOTEST Cust 22878, Contacts 0 / Assets 0). No New Contact modal opened at any point during the 6-second observation window (dialogVisible=0 throughout). (A separate, unrelated 'Google Maps' error dialog appeared on the customer page.)
notes: On staging the New Contact modal still does not appear after customer creation, matching the reported behavior. The reporter noted the behavior can be intermittent ('sometimes appears briefly'); in this single run it never appeared. Verdict STILL-REPRODUCES; confidence medium due to the reported intermittency.
